title: Keep Claude runtime permissions aligned when crossing read-only mode
outcome: Consolidated review of dc489248/8670fd85 (Codex session-6724 clean, Claude session-6725 Low): src/session_config.rs:530 hot-applies Claude approval mode using SetPermissionMode without respawning. Entering ReadOnlyAutoApprove through the local API therefore does not install the spawn-only ask-all/no-hooks/no-sandbox-auto-allow overlay. Leaving the mode can retain the overlay. Reject caller-supplied internal read-only mode or reset runtime on boundary crossings; test both transitions through the settings API, including preservation of active delegation settings locks.
